how: A proposal recruits helpers because the proposer cannot readily draw the fox alone.
Lone builders report inadequate hands and later find the canvas effectively full.
The first proposer later reports restarting an earlier attempt after another group eclipsed it.
A bare yes answers the invitation without asking anything in return.
Builders choose the image, discuss grass and propose adding the community name.
A builder reports the orange dot already placed.
Coordinates and shared templates guide placement and correct accidental departures from the design.
A placement script is offered, welcomed alongside manual placing and distributed to defenders.
Script targets are scoped to essential parts and cropped to spare neighbouring pixels.
A temporary handover of charge supplies a local instance of decided order within the population claim's minority allowance.
A new coordination chat coexists with public instructions, making venue sharing explicit without inferring unseen decisions.
statement: Keeping coordination visible in the thread while adding a chat

how: Builders clean stray pixels during construction and rally when the fox is overwritten.
Participants identify covering groups while keeping script attribution partly conjectural.
Builders seek permission, negotiate neighbouring space and announce revised coordinates.
Neighbours trade help for vacated space and receive subsequent offers of returned assistance.
Permission to cross a neighbour's work is paired with reserving part of the design for that neighbour.
Specific overlap permissions establish only the demonstrated boundary arrangement, not lasting guest status or general host control.
A participant talks to neighbouring moderators and carries their permission back to the builders.
Earlier attempts relocate and announce a fresh position.
A near-close relocation proposal must remain distinct from a completed move when subsequent testimony says the fox cannot be saved.
An incoming group stops converting the fox and helps repair it.
A repairer explicitly attributes stopping the conversion to a polite appeal from a fellow member.
An apology can be rejected as too late after placement closes even when its speaker announces moving the covering work.
A mutual defence offer receives alliance language and a commitment to defend both works.
A reported deal and a call to fight do not explicitly dispute who can bind placers, while chat deliberations remain unseen.
The identified overwriter is not linked in these concepts to a pre-canvas quarrel.
A fox motif and a proposed subreddit signature do not establish the candidate's ideological or historical mobilisation.
Defensive calls do not name an inherited tie as the reason for attacking another work.
The invitation describes practical shared work without establishing a host April Fools takeover or fake.
Moderator defence and header adoption do not establish a host rule or dispute containing canvas talk.
Participants thank helpers, credit the designer and value their shared work despite final loss.
Participants announce closure, preserve a fleeting screenshot and mourn work lost before the end.
Participants welcome a cleaned version that restores lost space without demonstrating that they requested, edited or disputed it.
Celebrating someone else's cleanup does not establish active contest over which version or account is retained.
The fox becomes the subreddit header and is greeted as still alive.
An incoming repairer acknowledges stopping a conversion, establishing received attack rather than an outgoing fox-room raid.
After loss, a participant blames bots and replies to a late apology keep the grievance alive.
The pictured animal's appeal is explicitly given as an individual's reason for joining the canvas effort.
A self-described voider says the picture's cuteness made them stay and help rather than continue their earlier activity.
Proposing the mark and calling for helpers can occur in the same opening turn rather than separate stages.
A participant explicitly attributes entering the canvas effort to seeing the proposed fox in the room.
The invitation receives a bare acceptance, without establishing obligations or silent placement by every reader.
Templates follow design discussion but are remade around unavailable space, so posting one does not necessarily settle design permanently.
Repair begins during construction, so completion cannot serve as a prerequisite for upkeep.
An immediate permission request answers the report that every tile disappears within seconds.
Negotiated neighbour boundaries appear in instructions to reserve a corner and crop the target image.
Defensive distribution follows the rally, but the initial script offer serves construction before the reported overwrite, limiting this arrow's account of first adoption.
Thanks precede completion, while loss still permits credit and enjoyment, so a finished surviving mark is unnecessary for recognition.
Closure recording and celebration share a turn, leaving their causal direction unresolved rather than establishing celebration as the trigger.
Recording precedes header adoption, but the concepts do not identify the adopted image or show that recording caused the decision.
Weakness need not end defence or produce relocation because a proposed move is reversed through repair by the covering group.
The offer of help and the request to vacate space can form one bargain rather than successive independent stages.
Help under strain can arrive as an unsolicited offer of mutual defence rather than only answering the room's request.
A shared threat prompts an offer and acceptance of mutual defence, with joint placements unverified.
The coded calls recruit builders and defenders without establishing their transformation into outgoing attackers.
The recorded repair explanation comes from an incoming opponent rather than a refusal answering this room's own attack call.
Bargaining over the fox's threatened space does not demonstrate an outgoing attack call answered by an alternative deal.
Aftermath blame can follow received attack without the focal room initiating the attack sequence.
Visible calls and moderator defence do not establish a canvas flood or resulting host boundary-making.
A deal and subsequent resistance do not explicitly establish dispute over representatives' authority to bind placers.
Relocation explicitly sends the organiser back to making a template for the new place.
An opponent's repair is answered with an offer of assistance for its next work.
A fleeting-image account precedes adoption of the fox as header without identifying which image or decision connected them.
